battle.name: 伊斯蘭教一次內戰
battle.theater: 伊拉克巴士拉西南原野
battle.brief: 伊斯蘭教一次內戰是哈里發國第一場內戰。前哈里發奧斯曼遇刺後，阿里在伊拉克巴士拉西南原野與艾伊莎、塔勒哈、祖拜爾的聯軍對峙，四月六日爆發駱駝之戰。卡面羅馬標槍代表以重投槍破盾、再以短劍近戰的古典兵法；七世紀雙方實攜的則是薩珊與拜占庭邊防技術的末端產物——合弓、長矛與重圓盾。

kit.name: 羅馬標槍
kit.history: 半米長的投槍，槍幹中空。捅穿盾之後就折斷，敵人只能帶著半截槍退回掩體。

countries: 交戰的兩翼都不是國家軍隊，而是按部落與庇護關係臨時湊成的聯軍。阿里·本·阿比·塔利卜一方以伊拉克的庫法為基地，庫法原是薩珊王朝在兩河下游的舊軍鎮，阿拉伯征服後被改造成哈里發國的伊拉克總督府與軍械庫；這一方的兵源是塔米姆、基納奈、阿卜杜·卡伊斯等阿拉伯部落的戰士，加上在薩珊與拜占庭邊防體系中受過操練的伊拉克老兵與波斯裔軍人。另一方是艾伊莎·本特·哈比卜、塔勒哈·本·祖拜爾、祖拜爾·本·阿瓦姆的聯軍，核心是麥加古萊什貴族與伍麥葉氏族的支持者，集合地在希志志西部的巴達爾；其骨幹是艾伊莎的家臣武裝、受過敘利亞邊境訓練的敘利亞與波斯裔士兵，以及因阿里廢除舊有分封與免稅而反彈的麥加權貴。火線的第三端是敘利亞總督穆阿維葉，他沒有在巴士拉現身，卻掌握羅馬邊境上的阿拉伯軍團、敘利亞行省的稅收與行政機構，決定了戰爭最後的政治走向。哈里發國此時仍屬協商制，沒有常備中央軍與統一軍械來源，雙方裝備多靠徵召時的部落自備，以及沿用前拜占庭與薩珊留下的軍械傳統。
countriesEn: Neither side of the first civil war of the caliphate was a state army. Both were coalitions raised on the spot out of tribes and networks of patronage. Ali ibn Abi Talib held Kufa, formerly a Sasanian garrison town on the lower Euphrates that the conquest had turned into the caliphate's Iraqi capital and arsenal; his men were the fighting men of the Arab clans of Tamim, Kinana and Abd al-Qays, together with Iraqi veterans and Persian-descended soldiers drilled in the Sasanian and Byzantine frontier systems. The other coalition was led by Aisha bint Abi Bakr, Talha ibn Ubayd Allah and Zubayr ibn al-Awwam, built around the Meccan Quraysh nobility and the clan of Umayya, mustered at Badr in the west of the Hijaz; its backbone was Aisha's household troops, Syrian and Persian-descended soldiers trained on the Syrian frontier, and the Meccan notables angered by Ali's cancellation of the old grants and tax exemptions. At the far end of the same front stood Muawiya ibn Abi Sufya, governor of Syria, who never appeared at Basra but held the Arab forces of the Roman frontier, the revenues of the Syrian provinces and their administrative machinery, and who decided the political end of the war. The caliphate was still a consultative confederation with no standing central army and no single source of equipment, so both sides were largely equipped out of tribal contributions and out of the arsenal tradition left behind by Byzantium and Sasanian Persia.
people: 關鍵人物有六位。哈里發奧斯曼·本·阿夫凡是第一個引爆點：他在巴士拉總督府遇刺身亡，卻沒有留下指定繼承人，繼承程序自此成為整場內戰的爭的所在。阿里·本·阿比·塔利卜是先知的堂弟兼女婿，由麥加權貴組成的協商會議推舉為哈里發，上任後停發奧斯曼晚期分封給麥加權貴的田產與養老津貼、廢除古萊什部的免稅，因此與艾伊莎等人決裂。艾伊莎·本特·哈比卜是先知之妻、信士之母，自幼練習騎射與戰陣，率軍進入伊拉克，據古典記載在戰鬥中坐於駱駝背上的高架平台指揮，肩部中箭後在戰鬥第三日（一說第二日）去世，葬於巴達爾。祖拜爾·本·阿瓦姆與塔勒哈·本·祖拜爾是聯軍的武力支柱：祖拜爾戰死，屍身被尋回時已失盔甲，塔勒哈在戰前被矛刺穿手掌，重傷之下仍躍馬衝鋒而陣亡。穆阿維葉·本·阿比·蘇菲亞以敘利亞軍力作後盾，不直接參戰卻以仲裁與談判消耗阿里，最終在阿里遇刺後登上哈里發位。此外還有仲裁人阿姆魯·本·阿斯與阿卜杜拉·本·伊本·哈桑、庫法軍官庫邁勒·本·齊亞德·阿薩迪、陣亡的烏拜杜·本·賈拉赫，以及在乃赫魯萬被鎮壓的哈瓦利吉派首領拉希爾·本·努曼。
peopleEn: Six figures decide the course of the war. Caliph Uthman ibn Affan is the first spark: he was struck down in an attack on his residence in Basra and died without naming a successor, and the question of how the next caliph should be chosen became the stake of the whole conflict. Ali ibn Abi Talib, the Prophet's cousin and son-in-law, was selected by a council of Meccan notables and then broke with Aisha, Talha and Zubayr over his refusal to continue the estates and pensions granted to the Meccan elite under Uthman and his cancellation of the Quraysh tax exemptions. Aisha bint Abi Bakr, wife of the Prophet and Mother of the Believers, had been trained in riding and shooting from childhood, led the army into Iraq, and according to the classical accounts directed the battle from a raised litter on the back of a camel; she was struck in the shoulder, died of the wound on the third day of the fighting according to most accounts and the second according to others, and was buried at Badr. Zubayr ibn al-Awwam and Talha ibn Ubayd Allah were the military spine of the coalition: Zubayr was killed in the battle and his body was recovered stripped of its armour, while Talha had the hand of his sword arm run through by a spear before the fighting began, charged on despite the wound and was killed. Muawiya ibn Abi Sufya, with the Syrian army behind him, never fought in Iraq but wore Ali down through arbitration and negotiation, and climbed to the caliphate after Ali's assassination. Others who matter are the arbiters Amr ibn al-As and Abdullah ibn al-Hasan, the Kufa officer Kumayl ibn Ziyad al-Asadi, Ubayda ibn al-Jarrah who fell in the battle, and Rashid ibn Nu'man, the Kharijite leader whose remnant was broken up at Nahrawan.
kits: 卡面兵器是羅馬標槍：公元前一世紀以來帝國步軍的核心投射兵器，約半米長的灰白木槍，中空槍幹，套筒接一枚錐形鐵矛頭，命中盾牌後槍頭彎折或槍幹斷裂，敵兵無法用槍推開盾面，攻擊者便可棄盾，或改以短劍補上致命一擊。嚴格說，實物形態的標槍在七世紀已不復存在，晚期羅馬把它換成長柄刺槍與擲矛，步兵骨幹改由摔矛兵與弓箭手擔當。656年兩軍真正攜帶的，是這條技術譜系的末端產物：來自薩珊與拜占庭邊防體系的長矛手與擲矛手、重圓盾、鎖子甲與札甲、佩箭袋與合弓、長直雙刃劍，以及穆阿維葉治下敘利亞前線久經戰陣的騎兵。巴士拉之役的考古發現與記述都顯示，決定戰局的並非投槍，而是弓陣的齊射、騎兵的兩翼機動，以及旗手與指揮官的傷亡。標槍在這場戰爭裡的位置因此是一個已經退場的祖型：它代表的是用重投槍破盾、再以劍近戰的兵種邏輯，而它的對應物，也就是重圓盾與近身纏鬥，恰恰還留在艾伊莎與祖拜爾聯軍的裝備上，因為那批戰士的盾牌正是從薩珊與拜占庭軍械系統裡傳下來的。
kitsEn: The card shows the Roman pilum, the standard missile of the imperial infantry from the first century BC: a shaft of pale ash about half a metre long, hollow, socketed to a pyramidal iron head, which bent or snapped on impact so that the shield could not be pushed aside, leaving the attacker to drop the shield or finish the man with the short sword. Strictly speaking the physical pilum no longer existed in 656; the late empire replaced it with the long thrusting spear and the javelin, and rested its infantry on missile troops and archers. What the two armies actually carried in 656 was the end of that technical lineage: long spearmen and javelin throwers drawn from the Sasanian and Byzantine frontier systems, heavy round shields, mail and lamellar armour, quivers and composite bows, straight double-edged swords, and the veteran cavalry of the Syrian frontier under Muawiya. Both the archaeology of the site and the written accounts of the fighting suggest that the outcome was decided not by thrown spears but by massed arrow fire, mounted movement on the flanks, and the loss of banner-carriers and commanders. The place of the pilum in this war is therefore that of an ancestor that has already retired: it stands for the tactical logic of breaking a shield with a heavy thrown spear and then closing with the sword, and its counterpart in that logic, the heavy round shield and the close brawl, is precisely what Aisha's and Zubayr's coalition still carried, because those shields came down through the Sasanian and Byzantine arsenals.
tactics: 戰術層面看，這是一場以部落聯軍為骨架的野戰。阿里據庫法與希拉，向北推進至幼發拉底河上游的麥迪克，封住艾伊莎自南方進入伊拉克的路線，再用巴士拉東北的沼澤與鹽鹼地限制她騎兵的展開。艾伊莎聯軍則利用從希志志到伊拉克的荒漠長距離補給線，單峰駱駝輸送糧水，行軍縱隊拉得極長，缺水與疲勞是全軍最實際的敵人。駱駝之戰本身是兩軍在開闊地上的正面對撞：聯軍以艾伊莎的駱駝與旗幟樞紐為軸心，阿拉伯騎兵在兩翼反覆衝擊，阿里的中軍在鹽灘上以步兵與投射武器遲滯，雙方在混戰中纏鬥數日，傷亡多數來自近身刀劍與長矛刺擊，而非遠程投射。聯軍崩潰的直接原因，是多名旗手與指揮官在同一天陣亡或重傷，陣形失去牽引核心；戰後阿里轉向哈瓦利吉派，在乃赫魯萬仍用同一套打法：以縱隊深入沼澤，分割敵軍各部，再迫使對方離開沼澤地帶。整體而言，駱駝提供了阿拉伯世界前所未有的機動性，戰役節奏、補給速度與戰場轉向都由單峰駱駝決定；長矛與投槍只能在這樣的機動框架之內發揮作用，脫離了馬匹與水源的支撐，裝備的精確度再高也無從施展。
tacticsEn: Tactically this was a field battle fought on a tribal skeleton. Ali held Kufa and Hira, pushed north to the upper Euphrates, sealed Aisha's southern approach into Iraq at al-Madiq, and used the marshes and salt flats north-east of Basra to restrict the deployment of her cavalry. Aisha's coalition exploited the long desert line from the Hijaz into Iraq, moving grain and water on single-humped camels, with the marching column stretched out over a great distance, and lack of water and fatigue were the most practical enemies of the whole army. The Battle of the Camel was a collision in the open: the coalition's axis was the camel bearing the banners and Aisha's litter, Arab cavalry struck repeatedly at both flanks, and Ali's centre stalled on the salt flats under missiles, the two sides grappling at close quarters for several days, with most losses coming from sword work and thrusting spears rather than from distant shooting. The immediate cause of the coalition's collapse was that several banner-carriers and commanders were killed or mortally wounded on the same day, so the formation lost its point of traction. Afterwards Ali turned on the Kharijites and used the same method at Nahrawan: columns pushed deep into the marshes, the enemy split into separate bands and forced out of its ground. Overall, the camel gave the Arab world an unprecedented mobility, and the tempo of operations, the speed of supply and the ability to turn the field all followed from the single-humped camel. The long spear and the thrown spear could only operate inside that mobile frame; cut off from horse and water, no amount of precision in the equipment could be brought to bear.
data: 可用的數字主要來自古典阿拉伯史家的記載，必須打折看待。巴士拉原野之戰的傳統記載說雙方合計約一萬四千人：艾伊莎、塔勒哈與祖拜爾一方約七千人，馬利克·本·拉比率率的巴士拉守軍約兩千人，阿里一方約七千人。戰鬥持續約兩至三日，艾伊莎於第三日（部分記載作第二日）因傷去世，葬禮在麥加的巴達爾舉行。乃赫魯萬之戰的哈瓦利吉派兵力沒有可靠數字，古典文獻只說叛軍在薩瓦沼澤中分批集結，待各部族相繼倒戈才崩解。編年本身則存在未解的矛盾：奧斯曼於656年6月遇刺，阿里受推舉的日期古典記載多寫作同年5月25日，兩者無法先後排列；仲裁在656年12月至657年1月於阿德魯赫達成；駱駝之戰的傳統日期是沙班35年，以通行的曆表換算約為656年4月6日，但此日期早於同年6月的奧斯曼遇刺，學界因此有把該役整體推到656年之後的修正說法，爭議至今未解。阿里於661年1月26日在庫法清真寺遇刺，內戰至此收束，整場內戰歷時約五年，而巴士拉一役本身不足一個月。距離方面，麥加至巴士拉的陸路約一千二百公里，聯軍全靠單峰駱駝完成這段補給；武器消耗與彈藥統計沒有留下可用數字。
dataEn: The usable figures come mainly from the classical Arabic historians and have to be discounted. The traditional account of the battle on the plains outside Basra gives about fourteen thousand men in all: some seven thousand for Aisha, Talha and Zubayr, about two thousand for Malik ibn al-Rabi' and the garrison of Basra, and about seven thousand for Ali. The fighting lasted some two to three days; Aisha died of her wounds on the third day according to most accounts, the second according to others, and was buried at Badr near Mecca. No reliable number survives for the Kharijite force at Nahrawan; the classical sources say only that the rebels assembled in bands in the marshes of the Sawra and collapsed as tribe after tribe changed sides. The chronology itself carries an unresolved difficulty: Uthman was assassinated in June 656, while the council that made Ali caliph is usually dated to 25 May of the same year, and the two cannot be ordered as given; the arbitration at Adruh was reached between December 656 and January 657; the Battle of the Camel is conventionally dated to Sha'ban 35, which converts to 6 April in the common reckoning, and some scholars have therefore pushed it to a later year, without the dispute ever being closed. Ali was assassinated in the mosque at Kufa on 26 January 661, which closed the war after roughly five years, while the battle at Basra itself lasted less than a month. On distance, the land route from Mecca to Basra is about twelve hundred kilometres and the coalition carried its supply over it on single-humped camels; no usable figures survive for ammunition consumption.
cause: 起因分三層。第一層是權力交接：奧斯曼在巴士拉遇刺身亡，卻沒有指定繼承人，由麥加權貴組成的協商會議推舉阿里，程序與合法性從此成為爭議核心，而承認與否認這場推舉，成了內戰的分野。第二層是政策衝突：阿里上任後停發奧斯曼晚期分封給麥加權貴的田產與津貼，並廢除古萊什部的免稅，艾伊莎、塔勒哈、祖拜爾自認遭到清算。他們離開麥地那，集合在麥加西南的巴達爾，組軍北上進入伊拉克，企圖奪取總督府，逼阿里讓步。第三層是宗派分裂的雛形：在戰爭爆發前，既拒絕接受阿里裁定的哈瓦利吉派已帶著一部分人分出，形成三方鼎立，誰都不接受對方的正統性。艾伊莎一方的訴求是血債血償與恢復奧斯曼時期的待遇，穆阿維葉在敘利亞則以邊疆軍力與行政資源靜待其變。最後把政治爭議推上戰場的，是巴士拉總督馬利克·本·拉比亞對艾伊莎的封鎖，以及阿里決定用軍隊把她擋在幼發拉底河對岸。
causeEn: The causes stack in layers. The first is the transfer of power: Uthman was killed at Basra without naming a successor, and a council of Meccan notables selected Ali, so the procedure and the legitimacy of that selection became the dividing line, and whether one accepted it decided everything. The second is a clash of policy: Ali stopped the estates and pensions that had been distributed to the Meccan elite under Uthman and cancelled the Quraysh tax exemptions, and Aisha, Talha and Zubayr understood themselves to be punished for it. They left Medina, mustered at Badr south-west of Mecca, marched north into Iraq and tried to seize the governor's residence in order to force Ali to give way. The third layer is the embryo of sectarian division: before the war even began, the Kharijites, who would accept neither Ali's arbitration nor Aisha's claim, had already taken a slice of their own away, leaving three parties that recognised none of the others as legitimate. Aisha's side framed its case as blood for blood and a restoration of the arrangements of Uthman's time, while Muawiya in Syria waited with the frontier forces and the administrative resources of his provinces. What finally pushed the political quarrel onto the field was Malik ibn al-Rabi' closing Aisha out of Basra and Ali's decision to hold her on the far bank of the Euphrates with an army.
impact: 影響分即時與長遠兩層。即時層：巴士拉之役後，統治阿拉伯的哈里發從協商式選舉轉為以軍隊與土地分封為基礎的權力競逐，庫法成為阿里的基地，敘利亞的穆阿維葉與伊拉克的哈里發形成兩極，接下來四年雙方以邊境襲擊與休戰互相消耗，布爾斯·本·阿比·阿爾塔特率領的縱深襲擊把戰線推到安納托利亞東緣，逼近君士坦丁堡的邊境省份。長遠層：阿里於661年在庫法被哈瓦利吉派刺客伊本·穆勒傑姆刺殺，兩個兒子哈桑與侯賽因先後讓位或被殺，第二次內戰在680年以侯賽因戰死卡巴拉收場，什葉派、蘇尼派與哈瓦利吉派的分裂由此固定。制度層：哈里發的合法性從此長期存在世襲與協商兩種互相排斥的敘述，阿拔斯王朝最終以先知血脈的名義挑戰世襲制，用了兩百多年才真正取代伍麥葉。裝備與戰術層：這場內戰把薩珊與拜占庭邊防體系的技術遺產整批帶進哈里發國家，重圓盾、長矛與合弓的組合自此定型為伊斯蘭世界陸戰的基本面貌。
impactEn: The effects work on two levels. In the immediate term, the battle outside Basra turned succession to the caliphate from an act of consultation into a contest fought with armies and with the distribution of land. Kufa became Ali's base, Syria under Muawiya and the Iraqi caliphate formed the two poles, and for the next four years the two wore each other down with frontier raids and truces, the deep raids of Busr ibn Abi Artat carrying the war out to the eastern edge of Anatolia and against the border provinces of Constantinople. In the long term, Ali was killed at Kufa in 661 by the Kharijite assassin Ibn Muljam; his sons Hasan and Husayn then either submitted or were killed, and the second civil war closed in 680 with the death of Husayn at Karbala, fixing the division between Shiite, Sunni and Kharijite. At the level of institutions, two incompatible stories of where legitimacy comes from, hereditary and consensual, ran against each other for the rest of the caliphate's existence, and the Abbasids finally challenged the hereditary principle in the name of the Prophet's bloodline, needing two more centuries to displace the Umayyads for good. At the level of equipment and tactics, this war carried the technical inheritance of the Sasanian and Byzantine frontier systems wholesale into the new caliphate, and fixed the combination of heavy round shield, long spear and composite bow as the standard face of land warfare in the Islamic world.
result: 結果分三層。戰役層：駱駝之戰中，艾里的聯軍在慘烈的近身纏鬥後獲勝，祖拜爾戰死，艾伊莎中箭重傷後去世，聯軍崩散；烏拜杜·本·賈拉赫陣亡，馬利克·本·拉比亞的頭顱被送到艾伊莎面前。此役之後，艾伊莎一方再無力集結，麥加貴族的聯盟在戰場上被摧毀。內戰層：穆阿維葉以敘利亞軍力為後盾，與阿里在657年達成為期約一年的休停，其後阿里轉向鎮壓哈瓦利吉派，在乃赫魯萬擊潰其殘部，再北上遊擊敘利亞前線，兵力與士氣被拖垮；661年1月26日阿里在庫法清真寺遇刺身亡，其子哈桑繼位並選擇服從穆阿維葉。政治層：穆阿維葉在同年成為哈里發，開創伍麥葉王朝，把哈里發國從協商制改為以敘利亞官僚體系與軍隊為核心的王朝統治；一次內戰至此結束，穆阿維葉與阿里的對立線只是被推遲到680年重演，主角換成侯賽因與卡巴拉。對裝備史而言，這場戰爭也留下一個反面註腳：當勝負不再由投射武器與防護之間的技術差距決定，而由忠誠、馬匹、糧水與戰場縱深決定時，古典的標槍與它的對應物，也就是重圓盾，都會退到背景裡去。
resultEn: The outcome has three layers. On the field: at the Battle of the Camel, Ali's coalition won after days of brutal close fighting. Zubayr was killed, Aisha was mortally wounded by an arrow and died, and the coalition broke up; Ubayda ibn al-Jarrah fell, and the head of Malik ibn al-Rabi' was carried to Aisha on a lance tip. After this, Aisha's side could never muster again, and the Meccan noble coalition was destroyed on the field. Across the war: Muawiya, backed by the Syrian army, concluded a truce of about a year with Ali in 657; Ali then turned on the Kharijites, broke their remnant at Nahrawan, and raided the Syrian front, and his army and his morale were worn down; he was killed in the mosque at Kufa on 26 January 661, and his son Hasan succeeded him and chose to submit to Muawiya. Politically: Muawiya became caliph in the same year and founded the Umayyad dynasty, replacing the consultative arrangement with a state built around the Syrian bureaucracy and army. The first civil war was over, and the line of conflict between Muawiya and Ali was only postponed to 680, with Husayn and Karbala taking their places. For the history of equipment this war also leaves a warning: once the outcome is decided no longer by the technical gap between missile and armour but by loyalty, horses, water and the depth of the battlefield, the classical pilum and its answering shield, the heavy round one, both retreat into the background.
